biggest_catch: The referrer must have been a TogetherCU member for at least 90 days to qualify for the $50 referral bonus, and the whole incentive offer is only valid through December 31, 2026.
catches: Referrer must have been a TogetherCU member for at least 90 days to qualify for the $50 referral bonus.

Referred member must open a new consumer checking account (membership eligibility and account approval required); the referrer receives their incentive once the friend/family member opens their account.

Friend's extra $150 incentive requires posting within 60 days of checking account opening: one direct deposit of $500+, five Visa debit card point-of-sale transactions (no ATMs), and enrollment in eStatements.
Member must be in good standing at time of qualifying transaction; cash incentives subject to 1099 reporting.
All members must open and maintain a minimum $5 balance in a savings account.
TogetherCU reserves the right to cancel, modify, or terminate the program at any time.
